'''Brian Grieg Fry''' (born 1970) is an American researcher in [[biochemistry]] affiliated with the [[University of Queensland]] in [[Australia]], where he is an associate professor and heads the university's research division specializing in [[venom]]. Fry has appeared in a number of programs on [[Discovery Channel]]'s [[Science Channel]], and has been interviewed by popular science magazines including ''[[National Geographic (magazine)|National Geographic]]'', the [[BBC]]'s ''Focus Magazine'' and others.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.science.org.au/node/325876 |title=Biography of Brian Grieg Fry |website=Australian Academy of Science |access-date=18 March 2015 |archive-date=21 December 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141221154236/https://www.science.org.au/node/325876 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://global.oup.com/academic/product/venomous-reptiles-and-their-toxins-9780199309399?cc=de&lang=en |title=Venomous Reptiles and Their Toxins |website=Oxford University Press |access-date=<!-- add date -->}}</ref>
